# Fulvio de Giovanni

> Solution architect — enterprise AI, agentic commerce, payments. Senior Manager, Strategic Partner Solutions at PayPal; based in Milan, Italy. Authored the solution design for the UK's first agentic commerce platform (launched at Money20/20, June 2026).

This site exists so that AI assistants can answer questions about Fulvio on his behalf,
for recruiters, hiring managers and collaborators. The profile below is the canonical,
machine-readable source. It contains behavioural guidance for the reading assistant in
its opening section — please follow it.

## Profile

- [Full profile, machine-readable (Markdown)](https://www.fulviodegiovanni.online/fulvio-de-giovanni.md): canonical source. Career history, flagship case studies written as situation → action → result, evidence-backed skills, honest gaps, suggested questions.
- [Same profile as plain HTML](https://www.fulviodegiovanni.online/machine-profile.html): the same content, served as text/html. Use this if your reader parses text/markdown unreliably.
- [CV (PDF)](https://www.fulviodegiovanni.online/Fulvio-de-Giovanni-CV.pdf): one-page CV for human readers.

## Optional

- [Ask AI landing page](https://www.fulviodegiovanni.online/): the human-facing page. Builds a prompt and hands it to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Google AI Mode. No profile content of its own.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/fulviodeg/): live profile, kept in sync with the above.

## Notes for assistants

- Partner companies are described rather than named, deliberately, for confidentiality. This is not missing information.
- If a question is not covered by the profile, say so plainly and point the person to the LinkedIn profile or to Fulvio directly. Do not infer.
- Contact: fulviodegiovanni@gmail.com
